summary.name: BabyCatAGI
summary.one_liner: BabyCatAGI is a lightweight, roughly 300-line autonomous task-agent script on Replit, a mod of BabyBeeAGI and the original BabyAGI by Yohei Nakajima.
use_cases: Break a high-level objective into a list of tasks automatically
Run web research that searches, scrapes, and summarizes results
Experiment with a minimal autonomous agent loop
Learn how BabyAGI-style task agents are structured
Generate a combined summary report from multiple sub-task results
summary.what_it_does: BabyCatAGI is a small autonomous agent script, about 300 lines of code, built as an iteration on BabyAGI and BabyBeeAGI. A Task Creation Agent runs once to generate tasks, then an Execution Agent loops through them. Tasks can declare dependencies so later tasks pull in relevant earlier results. It has two tools, search_tool and text_completion, plus a "mini-agent" that can be used as a tool. The search tool combines searching, scraping, chunking, and extraction, and the results are combined into a summary_report. Setup is to fork it into a private Repl, add an OpenAI API key (required) and optional SerpAPI key, set the OBJECTIVE variable, and press Run.
notable: About 300 lines of code, intentionally lightweight
Task dependencies pass relevant results between tasks
Search tool chains search, scrape, chunking and extraction
Remixed from BabyBeeAGI and original BabyAGI
caveats: Requires an OpenAI API key; SerpAPI key is optional
Page does not state pricing or Replit plan requirements
Built as a continued iteration, not a production-ready product
